lines.text: Many learners say: We discussed about the plan.

native.tip: Kita bilang “diskusi tentang”, tapi discuss langsung diikuti topiknya, tanpa about.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “We discussed about the plan.” 😅 Setelah discuss, langsung topiknya: “We discussed the plan.” Dengarkan Kak Carlos, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “discuss”. Bilang “Let's discuss ...” tanpa about. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “diskusi tentang”, but discuss takes the topic directly, with no about.
en.caption: Ever say this? “We discussed about the plan.” 😅 After discuss, go straight to the topic: “We discussed the plan.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
